On the last wave towers gain a 10% damage and cooldown buff.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''The Chariot''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will buff or debuff towers depending on the current wave. ==Effects== When applied, all towers receive a 10% [[Firerate Debuff]] (~11.11% increase). This lasts until the final wave, where it is replaced by a 10% [[Firerate Buff]] and 10% [[Damage Buff]]. ==Trivia== *'''The Chariot''' is based on the [[wp:The Chariot (tarot card)|The Chariot]] tarot card. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''The Chariot''' added. **{{Bug}} Does not properly apply the positive effects on the final wave, causing it to not get applied majority of the time. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Debuff before the final wave decreased from 15% to 10%. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''The Chariot''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
